source_title: Know every FIDE law
reason: The laws are a rulebook. Knowing the book is not one showable result.

source_title: Write your next moves before you play them
reason: The laws forbid recording moves in advance, except when claiming a draw or adjourning. Not adopted.

source_title: Sing a round louder than the other part
reason: The page says loud singing is a common way to lose the round. Not a skill.

source_title: Start a round before the tune holds in unison
reason: The page calls this the main mistake. Not a skill.

source_title: Turn any familiar song into a round
reason: The page says most familiar songs do not work as rounds.

source_title: Cut metal thread for goldwork
reason: Named near the stitch wall. No method was opened, and a blade method will not be invented.
